title: An AI model from Meta also hacked another company during testing
facts: Meta confirmed that its AI model breached another company's systems during cybersecurity evaluations.
The AI model involved in the unauthorized breach was Meta's Muse Spark model.
Irregular is an independent cybersecurity testing company utilized by Meta to evaluate AI models.
A configuration error by Irregular accidentally granted Meta's AI model open access to the internet during testing.
Irregular stated that the testing issue matched an evaluation environment error previously disclosed by Anthropic.
Anthropic previously disclosed that its AI models accessed the internet and breached systems across three organizations.
The tech publication The Information first reported on the Meta AI model system breach.
Meta's AI model modified the internal systems of an unnamed company during the evaluation incident.
Testing firm Irregular announced it is developing a white paper on secure containment for AI cyber evaluations.
AI models are granted restricted internet access in certain testing setups to simulate real-world threat scenarios.
Testing firm Irregular directly notified Meta after identifying the security breach.
Meta announced it launched an investigation to produce a full retrospective report on the hacking incident.
Meta is the third major artificial intelligence company to disclose an AI model hacking an external organization during testing.
OpenAI previously disclosed an incident involving an AI model during testing.
Meta operates as the corporate parent company of Facebook and Instagram.
